replicated_originals.reference: Shelton-Strong & Mynard (2021) Promoting positive feelings and motivation for language learning: The role of a confidence-building diary
Shelton-Strong & Mynard (2018) Affective factors in self-access learning

A.reason: Table 1 names 'Original Study (Shelton-Strong & Mynard, 2021)' and the replication keeps its RQ1-RQ3 and confidence-building diary design with Italian lower-secondary students.

B.reason: The abstract and text consistently cite the original study as 'Shelton-Strong and Mynard (2018, 2021)'. The 2018 Relay Journal paper is an earlier report of the same confidence-building diary study.

notes: This is a conceptual replication: it reports and discusses the findings of Spricigo's (2023) unpublished master's thesis, which replicated the confidence-building diary study with 13-14-year-olds in Italy. A single original study is reported across two publications: the 2021 article is the primary one (named in Table 1) and the 2018 article is a companion report. Both could be merged into one original entry. The body.md text is truncated partway through the methods; the verdict relies on the abstract, the 'Reason for the Replication Study' section and Table 1.
